from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # --- input validation ---
    for name, arr in [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (log probs must be nonpositive)")

    # shape matching
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("all three input matrices must have the same shape")

    # threshold validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric type")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # --- normalized future-token weights (T01) ---
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)  # offset from first future token
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # helper to compute weighted loss for a candidate
    def weighted_loss(logp_row: np.ndarray) -> float:
        # loss = - sum( w_i * logp_i )
        return -float(np.sum(norm_weights * logp_row))

    margins = np.empty(n_candidates, dtype=float)
    keep_mask = np.empty(n_candidates, dtype=bool)

    for i in range(n_candidates):
        L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result[i, :])
        L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only[i, :])
        L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call[i, :])

        # T03: stronger counterfactual baseline
        L_minus = min(L_no_call, L_call_only)
        margin = L_minus - L_plus
        margins[i] = margin
        keep_mask[i] = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margins"}

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # --- input validation ---
    for name, arr in [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (log probs must be nonpositive)")

    # shape matching
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("all three input matrices must have the same shape")

    # threshold validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric type")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # --- normalized future-token weights (T01) ---
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)  # offset from first future token
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # helper to compute weighted loss for a candidate
    def weighted_loss(logp_row: np.ndarray) -> float:
        # loss = - sum( w_i * logp_i )
        return -float(np.sum(norm_weights * logp_row))

    margins = np.empty(n_candidates, dtype=float)
    keep_mask = np.empty(n_candidates, dtype=bool)

    for i in range(n_candidates):
        L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result[i, :])
        L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only[i, :])
        L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call[i, :])
